content.text: What best describes how you need to move the green plastic spatula in order to put it into the pot? Choices: A. 1 inch down, 15 inches left. B. 3 inches down, 12 inches left. C. 0 inches down, 15 inches left. D. 1 inch down, 20 inches left. Please answer directly with only the letter of the correct option and nothing else.
